items.exampleEn: This red umbrella belongs to my sister.
items.exampleZh: 這把紅色雨傘是我姊妹的。

items.exampleEn: I like to hang out with my cousins on weekends.
items.exampleZh: 我週末喜歡和表兄弟姊妹一起出去玩。

items.exampleEn: I ran to the corner and caught a bus.
items.exampleZh: 我跑到街角，趕上了一班公車。

items.exampleEn: My dad does the laundry every Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸每個星期天洗衣服。

items.exampleEn: Did your parents get married in Tainan?
items.exampleZh: 你爸媽是在台南結婚的嗎？

items.exampleEn: Mom is getting ready in her room.
items.exampleZh: 媽媽正在她房間裡準備。

items.exampleEn: Take a map so you don't get lost.
items.exampleZh: 帶張地圖，你才不會迷路。

items.sentenceEn: Who does this black phone belong to?

items.audioEn: We got lost on the way to the museum, so we were late.
items.audioZh: 我們在去博物館的路上迷路了，所以遲到了。
options: Their car stopped in the middle of the road
They didn't know where to go
They woke up much too late that day

items.sentenceEn: Can you help me do the laundry tonight?
items.sentenceZh: 你今晚可以幫我洗衣服嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The kids often hang out at the park after school.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們放學後常在公園閒晃。

items.stemEn: I need ten more minutes to ____ for the party.
items.stemZh: 我還需要十分鐘才能準備好去參加派對。

items.stemEn: Excuse me, does this bag ____ you? I found it on the bench.
items.stemZh: 不好意思，這個包包是你的嗎？我在長椅上撿到的。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, my cousin Mia got married. The wedding was in a small town in the mountains. In the morning, my father helped everyone get ready, and then we drove there. On the way, we got lost, but luckily a farmer showed us the way. After the wedding, I hung out with my cousins until late at night. I also found a ring on the floor, but nobody knew who it belonged to.
items.passageZh: 上星期六，我的表姊 Mia 結婚了。婚禮在山上的一個小鎮舉行。早上，我爸爸幫大家準備好，然後我們開車過去。路上我們迷路了，還好有一位農夫告訴我們怎麼走。婚禮結束後，我和表兄弟姊妹一起玩到深夜。我還在地上撿到一枚戒指，但沒有人知道那是誰的。

questions.questionZh: 他們在去婚禮的路上發生了什麼事？
婚禮結束後，「我」做了什麼？
options: 和表兄弟姊妹玩到很晚
幫忙把婚禮會場打掃乾淨

items.promptZh: 如果我們現在出門，就趕得上一班去學校的公車。
referenceEn: If we leave now, we can catch a bus to school.
We can catch a bus to school if we leave now.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 catch a bus、catch the bus 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 get the bus、make the bus 等）也算對
「如果」可寫，例如 if we leave now、if we go now 等，放句首或句尾都可以
「趕得上」可寫，例如 can catch、will catch 等

items.promptZh: 我姊姊預計明年六月結婚。
referenceEn: My sister is getting married next June.
My older sister will get married next June.
My sister is going to get married next June.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 get married 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 marry 等）也算對
未來的事可寫，例如 is getting married、will get married、is going to get married 等
「姊姊」可寫，例如 sister、older sister、big sister 等
